name: LMDeploy (TurboMind) on NVIDIA
description: AccelMark runner for NVIDIA GPUs using InternLM LMDeploy (C++/CUDA TurboMind backend). Supports continuous batching, streaming TTFT, and tensor parallelism.
notes: Validated on NVIDIA RTX 6000D (SM120) with LMDeploy 0.18.0 TurboMind backend. Upstream: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy
